Local synthetic 4/12/24-vessel comparison. No database, telemetry, or gameplay writes. Each case warms up for 1.5 seconds and samples for 3 seconds. Keep this tab visible and its size unchanged.

Frame intervals include browser scheduling. CPU submission time covers update and render calls; it is not GPU execution time. Update and render submission are also measured separately. Shadow cost disables shadows only in this fixture; production keeps them enabled. Detail comparisons use the same 2 MP limit and correct seal rendering in both cases. Pixel comparisons use merged details in both cases, comparing the former DPR-only limit against 2 MP.

The loader check uses a tiny uncompressed GLTF generated in memory. It checks distinct scene ownership, failure, and retry; it does not benchmark Draco compression.
